description:
Get the status, cost and files of one presentation.

status: pending/running (the agent is working: ask again in a minute or two), awaiting_input (a turn is
done: result is ready and revise_presentation is possible), completed, failed (error says why) or archived.
When result is set, give the user result.pptx_url (editable PowerPoint) and result.pdf_url, and show result.slides
(n, title, image_url); result.deck is the presentation map (goal, audience, theme, slide plan) and
result.changelog says what changed in this version. last_agent_message is the agent's own summary. While a
revision runs, result is still the previous version. Links are signed and last about a day: call again for fresh ones.
name: get_presentation
